events.text: Buzek was elected President of the European Parliament with 555 votes of the 644 votes cast.

events.quote: On 14 July 2009 , Buzek was elected President of the European Parliament with 555 votes of the 644 votes cast

events.subject: self
events.quote: He succeeded the German Christian Democrat MEP , Hans-Gert Pöttering .
